notes_for_editor: Single source: the FFLOS register page. The Forest Lookouts Cherry Hill page has the name and section heading but no entries, so no staffing or fire records were used. One WebSearch found nothing about this lookout (results were Wolf Mountain and Grouse Ridge, not this site). Nothing conflicts with the register, but the site's present condition and access are not described anywhere we read. Brief record checked: kind, county, agency, coordinates, elevation and built year match.
